races.verdict: RIDE LIKE A GIRL holds the clear edge on form and looks to have been found a good opportunity to bag a second success over hurdles. Tom George has his string in excellent nick and his Worcester bumper scorer Dark Tide Rising appeals as the one to chase home Jamie Snowden's mare ahead of fellow hurdling newcomer Whin Cover . RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR) DARK TIDE RISING (IRE) WHIN COVER

races.display_title: Autumn Racing Weekend Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Male Amateurs)
races.verdict: This is wide open. TEX has gained both his victories here (first over C&D) and scored in good style in amateur company last time out so is fancied to defy a 6 lb weights rise with Simon Walker a significant booking. Recent Ffos Las winner Kaleidoscope Eyes heads the list of dangers under a 5-lb penalty, although Rock Opera is weighted to go well and represents last year's successful connections. Norcross Brow is another who can play a prominent role in his bid for a fourth win of 2026. TEX (FR) KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE) ROCK OPERA

races.verdict: This is wide open. LARKINS LANE took a step forward in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when a clear second in a big-field handicap at Kilbeggan last time and is weighted to go close off a 3 lb higher mark so edges the vote from hat-trick seeking Esticky End . Both No Big Deal and Getaway Charlie can also play a prominent role, while Mother Ship and At The Wings need factoring into this highly competitive handicap too.
